item.title: ‘Vibe Coding’ Inventor Andrej Karpathy Has a New Term for A.I. Engineering
item.description: A member of OpenAI’s 11-person founding team, Karpathy focused on generative modeling, computer vision and reinforcement learning at the ChatGPT-maker before leaving for Tesla in 2017 to lead its Autopilot efforts.

item.title: At Chef Andy Beynon’s Behind Restaurant, the Menu Shifts With the Sea
item.description: At the 18-seat Hackney restaurant, Beynon lets the day's catch dictate what lands on the plate.

item.title: A Rare First-Place Medal from the 1896 Olympics Comes to Auction
item.description: Another 1896 medal sold for nearly $112,000 in 2024; exceptional examples have sold for more than $200,000.

item.title: With a New U.S. Flagship, Bonhams Bets Big on Cross-Category Collecting
item.description: The auction house has transformed New York City's historic Steinway Hall into four stories of state-of-the-art auction rooms, enhanced galleries and client reception areas that can support cross-category engagement.

item.title: New York City’s Essential Puerto Rican Restaurants
item.description: The city's essential Puerto Rican restaurants trade flash for value, pork-centric menus and unapologetic authenticity.

item.title: The Volvo XC 60 T8 AWD Plug-In Hybrid Is a Modern Relic
item.description: Something about this vehicle feels trapped in amber, as if it's from another time.

item.title: On-Chain Banking and the Next Phase of Financial Infrastructure
item.description: WeFi CEO Maksym Sakharov examines the rapid emergence of on-chain banking as decentralized finance evolves into real-world financial infrastructure. The future of global finance, he contends, will depend on scalable, transparent systems that can deliver banking functionality without traditional intermediaries.

item.title: MrBeast Expands His Business Empire With Gen Z Banking App Acquisition
item.description: MrBeast is buying Step, a popular fintech app for teens, marking his first major push into digital banking and financial literacy.

item.title: Jonathan Carver Moore Is Rewriting the Gallery Playbook
item.description: "I don’t see limits when I’m trying to do something, and I don’t think anyone should. If I had gone through the so-called proper channels, I don’t think I would have done things the way I have.”

item.title: Dana Walden Faces Disney’s Franchise and Streaming Reckoning
item.description: As Bob Iger exits and Josh D’Amaro ascends, Dana Walden becomes the key figure shaping Disney’s stories, franchises and streaming future.
